scenes.headline: 4 Rivers
scenes.body: A free, scripture-based course on stewardship, made for young adults who want a faith-first way to handle money.

scenes.headline: Money and faith belong in the same conversation
scenes.body: Most of us were never taught how to manage what we earn. 4 Rivers fills that gap with short lessons in plain language.

scenes.headline: Four rivers, one source
scenes.body: In Genesis 2, one river flowed out of Eden and divided into four. Each river in this course is a principle of stewardship.

scenes.headline: Every lesson starts with the Word
scenes.body: Verses come in the KJV, NIV, NLT, and ESV, and every module can be read aloud.

scenes.headline: Ideas you can try with real numbers
scenes.body: Practice tools like the income impact calculator and a debt snowball show what steady habits can do over time.

scenes.headline: Watch an extra stream reshape the month
scenes.body: Add a second source of income and see how much more is left after the bills, and what that could mean over the years.

scenes.headline: A quiz after every river, then a final exam
scenes.body: Ten questions per river and a 50 question exam that ties all four together. Retake any of them as often as you like.

scenes.headline: An optional 30-Day Challenge
scenes.body: Want some structure? Daily tasks and a streak guide you through the whole course in a month, with the exam on day 30.

scenes.headline: A certificate anyone can verify
scenes.body: Pass the exam to earn a certificate with your name, a QR code, and a link that confirms it is real.
